name: Ningxia Zhongke Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningxia Zhongke Biotechnology Co., Ltd., established in 1958 and headquartered in Yinchuan, China, operates in the chemical sector. The company specializes in the production of both chemical raw materials and a diverse range of chemical products. Its manufacturing activities specifically encompass coal-based activated carbon, various lauric acid compounds, and biologically-derived chemical fibers.
